title: CM7-16.2.0.135SP15-OP006PF001AZ-16.3.0.140SP28-OP008PF001AZ_20260821114936
description:
It is recommended to perform OTA upgrade when the battery is over 50%.

Update Version:
CM7-16.3.0.140SP28(OP008PF001AZ)

Changed Functions:
AI
1. Fully upgraded the NMT (Neural Machine Translation) architecture to significantly improve the accuracy of Chinese speech recognition and the coherence of long-text translation, with support for more advanced semantic understanding.
2. Optimized AI subtitle generation for faster speeds and more accurate syncing with live video streams, improving the cross-language viewing experience.

Dynamic Port
1. Flight status recognition: After you copy a flight number, Dynamic Port can quickly display the real-time flight status (a trip app required).
2. Match tracking: Get real-time scores and reminders so you never miss a goal (a match subscription required in Phoenix or MovieBox).

AI Suggestions
1. Added TikTok recommendations to Dynamic Port, making it easier to discover trending videos in real time.
2. Added intelligent Lazada parcel tracking, so you can view delivery status at a glance.
3. Upgraded travel management across scenarios with support for international and cross-city travel cards that intelligently show itinerary information based on your location.

Privacy & Security
1. Optimized privacy permission management by expanding permission access alerts to home screen widgets and Zero Screen cards, giving you more transparent control over sensitive permissions.
2. Optimized cross-system data sharing. Sync capabilities now cover contacts and system settings, making switching between systems more seamless and consistent.

Communication
1. Updated call recording with automatic recording for selected contacts and optimized file naming for saved recordings.

Smoothness
1. Streamlined system services by rebuilding core services to reduce power consumption, improve performance, extend battery life, and deliver smoother operation.
2. Enhanced cleanup capabilities with deeper system junk scanning to free up storage more accurately.

Fixed Issues:
AI Gallery
1. Fixed issues in AI Gallery where Memories albums could fail to open properly, background music could fail to play, sub-albums could show a white screen, and full-resolution images could load incorrectly.
2. Fixed issues where image covers could load incompletely, transparent animated images could display abnormal backgrounds, and some new photos could be sorted by time inaccurately.

Home Screen & Themes
1. Fixed issues where, after device activation, cloud folder apps could reappear at the end of the home screen, and where lock screen clock styles could appear inconsistent before and after a global theme upgrade.
2. Fixed display issues with resizable icons and improved Launcher stability after home screen restoration on the following day, making long-term use more reliable.

Notifications
1. Fixed issues where email push notifications could fail to arrive, duplicate cards could appear in the notification bar during dual media playback, and notifications could be unresponsive after tapping upon multiple incorrect password attempts on the lock screen.
2. Fixed touch responsiveness issues in parts of the notification bar to improve interaction responsiveness.

Network & Connectivity
1. Fixed occasional issues where NFC door access could fail, the Wi-Fi connection screen could get stuck after a failed connection, and the Wi-Fi static IP page could be obscured by the keyboard.
2. Improved the display stability of 5G/4G signal icons.
3. Fixed the issue where connection status could display incorrectly after closing VPN apps.

Smoothness
1. Optimized multitasking, first-time swiping on Zero Screen, and browsing in popular social media apps for smoother animations.
2. Fixed stuttering in the screen unlock animation and lag when loading pop-ups
